topic: Day 135 — reel — Sometimes the most ambitious move is just protecting your ability to keep going
text:
Sometimes
ambition looks
like [pacing],
not pushing.
caption:
Protecting your ability to keep going is not a smaller goal. Burning out for a short-term target can cost you the long one.
